thread:
maria(oncall): paging team — I’m seeing elevated 95th latency for text-generation in us-west-2. error spikes ~10:37 UTC. opening war room, who can own?
incident-bot: Incident created (INC-2026-032): inference latency spike - us-west-2. War room: https://warroom.redwood.com/INC-2026-032 (expires in 4h). Pager: @maria(oncall) @raj(sre)
raj(sre): I can jump in, joining war room now. first step: confirm customer impact and whether autoscale kicked.
maria(oncall): thanks. autoscale shows 2 extra nodes spun up but CPU at 95%. KV cache miss rate up ~3x.
jenna(prod-eng): tagging in — could be a model variant fallback loop. are we seeing lots of model load/unload?
raj(sre): yes, logs show repeated model swap events for model: redwood-large-v1 at 10:35-10:38. suspect kernel OOM or eviction thrash. attaching quick grep: ```10:35:12 modelmanager: unloading model redwood-large-v1 pid=4432 rc=137
10:35:13 loader: failed allocate workspace rc=12
10:35:14 modelmanager: load attempt 2
```
sam(support): CS flagged a production customer (acct: AcmeCorp) in us-west-2 reporting slow responses. we should prepare a short customer notification once we confirm impact.
maria(oncall): owner = raj(sre) for mitigation, jenna(prod-eng) for model fallback plan, sam(support) will draft customer note. I’ll handle status page updates.
raj(sre): mitigation plan: 1) pin traffic to redwood-medium-v2 (compatible faster variant) via routing policy, 2) temporarily increase dedicated pool for us-west-2 by +2, 3) disable aggressive model swap for redwood-large-v1 by flipping feature flag. I’ll run steps in that order.
jenna(prod-eng): to add — enable aggressive KV prefill for active prefixes for the top 5 customer routes to reduce cold-starts. I’ll prepare the canary rollout for traffic pin.
maria(oncall): war room link posted: https://warroom.redwood.com/INC-2026-032 — join. confirm you have paging SMS? @raj @jenna @sam
raj(sre): confirmed. SMS to my phone and push. starting step 1 now: routing change to pin to redwood-medium-v2 (rolling changes via routing service).
statusbot: Routing policy update queued: route-group=us-west-2-generation, change-id=chg-98765, started=10:39:02 UTC.
maria(oncall): draft statuspage (short): ```We are currently investigating elevated latency for text-generation in the US-West region. Some requests may be slower or time out. Our engineers have identified model load thrash as a likely cause and are applying mitigations (traffic pinning and capacity bump). We will post updates here every 15 minutes or as we have new information. Impacted customers: services backed by redwood-large-v1 in us-west-2.``` Thoughts?
sam(support): looks good. Suggest adding targeted customer outreach line: "If you are experiencing degraded service, reply to this thread or open a support ticket and add "INC-2026-032" to expedite."
jenna(prod-eng): +1. add note that we may route to lower-latency variant which can change cost/quality slightly.
maria(oncall): updated status page and triggered a subscribe notification to affected customers. statusbot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai (INC-2026-032).
incident-bot: Pager update: escalation to secondary (raj) acknowledged at 10:40:01 UTC.
raj(sre): routing change applied, initial telemetry shows p50/p95 dropping — p95 from 1.8s -> 1.1s in firing group. starting capacity bump now.
statusbot: Dedicated pool scale +2 initiated for us-west-2 (pool-id dp-west-3). ETA ~90s.
sam(support): starting customer DM template: ```Hi <Customer>, we’re investigating elevated latency in us-west-2 affecting some generation APIs. Engineers are applying mitigations (traffic pin to faster variant + temporary capacity increase). We’ll update here within 15 minutes. Ref: INC-2026-032```
maria(oncall): good. post to AcmeCorp private thread once we confirm p95 stable <1.2s for 5m.
jenna(prod-eng): feature-flag flip to reduce model swap scheduled — applying in 1 min. will monitor for regressions.
raj(sre): capacity bump complete, KV miss rate down 45%, p95 ~0.9s now. holding for 5m for stability.
maria(oncall): confirmed. going to update status page to "mitigation in progress, user impact reduced" then prepare for postmortem template.
statusbot: Status updated: "Mitigation in progress — user impact reduced" at 10:45:12 UTC.
sam(support): sent proactive DM to AcmeCorp with interim note. they acknowledged.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-032: primary owner set to raj(sre). war room will stay open for 2h.
maria(oncall): thanks team. next actions: keep war room live, collect logs for model manager OOM, capture timeline, and schedule a 1h post-incident huddle. I’ll draft customer follow-up once we close.
raj(sre): copying commands used for rollback pin: ```curl -X POST https://routing.redwood.internal/api/v1/pin -d '{"route":"us-west-2-generation","model":"redwood-medium-v2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'```
jenna(prod-eng): adding to postmortem checklist: root-cause hypothesis, model memory footprint, kernel allocation pattern, and recommended mitigations (prefill, throttling, better eviction heuristics).
maria(oncall): perfect. I'll mark the thread as the canonical incident comms. If anyone sees a regression, reply here immediately. :thumbsup:
